upgrades.name: Reactive
upgrades.effect: Deals 2 damage to attacker’s device firewall per degree of failure.

upgrades.name: Scrambled
upgrades.effect: Increases lockout duration by 1 round per encryption tier.

upgrades.name: Smart
upgrades.effect: Turns hack into Opposed Test using Firewall Rating ×2 as Cryptography.

upgrades.name: Viral
upgrades.effect: Attacks intruding device each turn during lockout using Firewall Rating ×2.

upgrades.name: Dead-End
upgrades.effect: If attacker’s firewall tier is lower, reduce damage taken by 1.
